title: w-strictly local and w-contractible rings
statement:
Let $R$ be a ring and $T=\operatorname{Spec}R$, a spectral space with set $T^c$ of closed
points (the maximal ideals of $R$).

1. $R$ is *w-local* if $T^c$ is closed in $T$ and every prime of $R$ is contained in exactly
   one maximal ideal. By [det-pe-wlocal-components] this agrees with
   [def-weil-pbc-w-local]: $T^c$ closed and every connected component of $T$ has exactly
   one closed point.
2. $R$ is *w-strictly local* if it is w-local and, for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$,
   the local ring $R_{\mathfrak m}$ is strictly henselian
   [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology].
3. $R$ is *w-contractible* if it is w-strictly local and the profinite space
   $\pi_0(T)$ of connected components (with the quotient topology from $T$) is
   extremally disconnected: the closure of every open subset of $\pi_0(T)$ is open.
   Equivalently, by [det-pe-wlocal-components], the compact Hausdorff space $T^c$ (with
   the subspace topology) is extremally disconnected.

lean.statement: class IsWContractibleRing (R : Type*) [CommRing R] extends IsWStrictlyLocalRing R
lean.note: Exact existing definitions in the root namespace: IsWLocalRing and IsWStrictlyLocalRing from WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.WLocal, and IsWContractibleRing from WeilConjectures.RingTheory.ProEtale.WContractible. IsWLocalRing gives a w-local prime spectrum; WLocalSpace gives closed closed-points and uniqueness of closed specializations, with existence automatic for spectral spaces. IsWStrictlyLocalRing adds strict henselianity of Localization.AtPrime m for every maximal ideal m. IsWContractibleRing adds ExtremallyDisconnected (ConnectedComponents (PrimeSpectrum R)), using the quotient topology. The imported WLocalSpace.closedPointsHomeomorph identifies closed points with components and gives the equivalent closed-points formulation. No duplicate module is written.
